non_blocking: TR-2, after pressing Start in the startable state (walk-a-steps/03-a03-after-start-pressed.png): the dialog fetches the check again while the session runs, so its top line becomes 'This session runs "Write the Started note in notes.md" (about CHF 0.03).' with Start still on and the notice 'Started: the session works until nothing more can run...'. Meanwhile the Overview already says 'Waiting until 01:16'. StartSessionDialog fetches the check only on checkTick, never on session events, so the stale line stays until the dialog is reopened. It was not reachable before, because Start was off. Suggestion (polish-screens or a follow-up): for a startable blocker, say in the notice that the work waits for the reset and starts by itself then.

The fixer's own new_problems hold: while the only key rests and no wait is kept, the project header reads 'Ready to continue: 1 task ready · Continue' (walk-a-steps/06-a06). Also, the chooser's runs-on wait sentence ('Waits until ... and starts by itself.') in New task, the plan card and Settings promises a start that only a kept wait gives. This is a TR-2 sibling, logged, not fixed.

TR-3 / R-refusedstays: credentialWaitNow returns null as soon as the first ready task gets no billing request: a person's task, an unknown specialist, a ladder with no stand-in, or a thrown error (.catch(() => null)). The wake's servesNow then takes the project off a resting or refused source and starts a session. That session files the person's card and its other tasks meet the wait again (kept again), so nothing loops. Still, one task decides the whole project, and an error reads as 'can run'.

TR-13: task.addCost goes through updateWhere, which bumps the task's version from the background drain of a killed run. I checked the runner's killed path: it uses releaseClaim/recordMove, with no version-checked transition after the drain starts. Budget and timeout stops wait for Claude Code to exit, so they have no late tail. So I found no conflict today. A person's drawer action sent with a version read just before the tail lands could still get a version_conflict. Worth a line in runtime.md.

TR-1 has no fail-closed fallback. If a future Claude Code tightens a built-in tool's outputSchema so that a redacted string no longer validates, Claude Code silently uses the original (unredacted) output and only its own log says so. Forerunner does not detect this. The spec's fallback (deny the read of a file holding a resolved value) was not built, because the shapes could be confirmed for 2.1.304. Consider a test that runs redactToolOutput against the bundled tool output schemas, or a deny path for unknown shapes.
Cosmetic: in StartSessionDialog.tsx, PLANNING_WAIT_LINE and its JSDoc were inserted between startNotice's existing JSDoc and the function. startNotice's doc now sits orphaned above another doc block.

Wording for polish-words (design §5): 'Your agent is drafting a plan; this session starts once it is ready.' — 'it' could read as the session. 'the plan is ready', as the queued notice says, would be unambiguous. 'Press Start and it runs then.' is fine, but the notice after Start does not confirm 'then'.
With planning and ahead > 0, startNotice falls back to 'your agent is in another session, and N other starts wait...'. That is inexact during planning but rare.
